author: cli
text: THE HANDSHAKE IS SILENT ON EXACTLY THE INCIDENT IT WAS BUILT FOR. handle() calls this at mcp.py:296, AFTER tool[fn](repo, args) and inside the same try - so when the tool raises, the except at :301 returns a bare {error: ...} and the drift line is never computed, let alone attached. The incident this was written against (see the comment at :228) is an OLD server started before an upgrade, crashing on a map the new build re-indexed: in that state every tool raises, so there is never a successful response to carry the notice, and the reader gets 'TypeError: RawEdge.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument via_attr' with nothing saying restart your server. Reproduced twice on 2026-08-16: once in a rigged server (_SERVER_VERSION 0.50.1, installed 0.55.1 - the crashing call had keys ['error'] only, the next SUCCEEDING call announced drift), and once for real on this repo's own MCP server, where every tool crashed and nothing ever announced. FIX DIRECTION: compute drift before the call, or attach it in the except branch too - the notice belongs to the session, not to the success path.
